caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed cylindrical cup or vessel with slightly flared edges at the top and multiple concentric rings at the base. The entire object is rendered in shades of grey, with lighter areas suggesting highlights and darker, finely shaded areas indicating shadow and the curvature of the surface. The background consists of a plain, off-white or light beige color with no other objects or details present. The lines are soft and the shading is smooth, creating a subtle gradient effect over the surface of the cup. There is a faint signature in the lower right corner of the drawing area. The composition is simple, with the vessel occupying the majority of the space within a penciled rectangular border.
title: Silver Beaker
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
